websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Domains or URLs to check, e.g. shopify.com or https://example.com/pricing. One entry per site; a bare domain checks the homepage's capture history.

includeSnapshots.title: Include snapshot rows
includeSnapshots.description: Besides the one summary row per site, also emit one row per archived snapshot (at the chosen granularity) with status code, mimetype, size and a direct archive link.

granularity.title: Snapshot granularity
granularity.description: How densely to sample the archive. Yearly returns roughly one snapshot per year (best for vetting), monthly one per month, all returns every capture up to your caps.

fromYear.title: From year
fromYear.description: Only include snapshots from this year on. Leave 0 for no lower bound.

toYear.title: To year
toYear.description: Only include snapshots up to this year. Leave 0 for no upper bound.

maxSnapshotsPerSite.title: Max snapshot rows per site
maxSnapshotsPerSite.description: Cap on snapshot rows per site (the summary row does not count against this).

maxRows.title: Max rows total
maxRows.description: Maximum rows across all sites, summaries plus snapshots. First 2 rows per run are free.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. archive.org is scraper friendly and requests are paced, so proxy is off by default.
